home.heroDescription:
I’m Snake Konginchrist. I build mobile products, AI tools and research projects.
This is where I keep the things in progress and the questions that keep me curious.

about.heroDescription:
I’m Snake Konginchrist. With SK Studio I build mobile products and AI tools, while researching distributed optimization.
This is the personal record outside the work itself.
